cells.gaps: No rule in force, programme or delivery since October 2023 is found: the 2017 Act and the Ibsar project are known only from 2017 sources. The audit is an academic study of seven websites, not all of them public.
cells.note: A study published in April 2026 tested seven Sudanese academic, government and service websites against WCAG 2.1 AA and found critical barriers on all of them. A later yes answers the earlier ones, so 5.
